mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 2.5% over two consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, which raises real discount rates and reduces present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 of more than 2% indicates a significant weakening in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during episodes where GDPC1 falls by more than 2% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 4% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE exceeds 4% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in INDPRO below its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate earnings and capital expenditure, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12-month moving average for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of four consecutive months of INDPRO below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both GDPC1 and HOUST for two consecutive months indicates weakening housing and overall demand, which reduces consumer spending and investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A positive co-movement between PAYEMS and UNRATE above their respective 6-month averages for three months signals synchronized labor market strength, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 6-mo avg and UNRATE > 6-mo avg for three months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both PAYEMS and UNRATE exceed their 6-month averages for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp one-month increase in FEDFUNDS of more than 0.75 percentage points signals an aggressive tightening stance, which rapidly elevates borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative following a FEDFUNDS increase of more than 0.75% in one month.

mechanism_narrative: A positive co-movement between GDPC1 and RSAFS above their 12-month averages for three consecutive months signals robust private sector demand and cash flow, which supports higher corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 12-mo avg and RSAFS > 12-mo avg for three months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and RSAFS exceed their 12-month averages for three consecutive months.
